replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics has always been a bit of a struggle for me. I prefer subjects like history and chemistry where things feel more tangible and connected to real life. However, with my high neuroticism score, math often feels intimidating.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. My anxiety levels are high, so whenever complex numbers or abstract formulas appear, I tend to freeze up. It makes me avoid those topics unless I feel very safe and supported.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I have used AI tools recently, mostly for checking homework or finding step-by-step explanations. While sometimes helpful, I worry about accuracy because my anxiety makes me doubt everything easily. It's a mixed experience.
